name: The Twilight Camp
summary: Cultists gather around the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, and Alliance scouts seek to learn why. A scrying bowl has shown their ritual site; now you enter the excavation to discover what the Twilight's Hammer seeks beneath the earth.

sections.title: Probing the Dig
sections.body: The Twilight's Hammer has made the Master's Glaive an active threat. After a scrying bowl reveals the cultists' fortifications, you enter their camp to learn their designs before the Alliance can prepare its defenses.

sections.title: The Illustrated Tome
sections.body: The cultists' northern camp holds an ancient tome, printed by hand and filled with unsettling art. Its pages show that the Twilight's Hammer studies the colossal entity buried beneath the earth.

faq.q: What is the goal of The Twilight Camp quest?
aliases: what do i do twilight camp
faq.answer: You enter the Twilight's Hammer camp near the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore to recover a clue to the cult's motives: a hand-printed ritual book.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate the camp?
faq.answer: The Scrying Bowl at the overlook above the Master's Glaive sends you to investigate, continuing the inquiry begun for the ancient protector Onu.

faq.q: Where is the clue found in the camp?
faq.answer: The Twilight Tome lies in the northern part of the encampment. Other tomes can unleash warding magic against intruders.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer at the Master's Glaive?
aliases: why are cultists at masters glaive
faq.answer: The cultists seek the dark powers of the Old Gods and their servants. They dig around the massive petrified carcass pinned by the giant stone blade, to study or awaken whatever ancient evil remains there.

faq.q: What happens after finding the tome?
aliases: where to go after twilight tome
faq.answer: Finding the tome leads to Return to Onu. You carry the writings north to the ancient treant in the Grove of the Ancients.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you see the Twilight's Hammer defile sacred Kalimdor beneath the ancient groves of Darkshore.
As a Druid, you help Cenarion wardens uncover the cult's research and keep corrupting ancient entities buried.
As an Alliance member, you help stop the cult's strange excavations from destabilizing northern Kalimdor.
